events.task_created: A task was created, on the board or through the API.
events.task_stage_changed: A task moved to another stage.
events.chat_message: Someone or an agent wrote in a chat.
events.stages_changed: A board's columns changed: a stage added, edited, removed or reordered.
events.boards_changed: A board was created, renamed, deleted or made the default.
events.question_asked: An agent asked a person a question and waits for the answer.
events.question_canceled: An agent's question was canceled, by a person or because the task moved on without it.
events.approval_requested: A task needs someone's sign-off: a stage opened one, or an agent or a person asked for it.
events.approval_decided: Someone decided a sign-off: approved, changes requested or waived.

test.ok: Test delivery OK: HTTP {status} in {ms} ms

legacy.title: Signed with HMAC keyed by sha256(secret), not the secret itself. Rotate the secret to fix it.

note.one: One endpoint signs with a key derived from the secret you were shown, so a receiver checking X-Octopus-Signature with that secret rejects every delivery. Rotate the secret on each endpoint marked derived-key signing, then give the receiver the new one: from then on it signs with HMAC-SHA256 keyed by the secret itself.
note.other: {count} endpoints sign with a key derived from the secret you were shown, so a receiver checking X-Octopus-Signature with that secret rejects every delivery. Rotate the secret on each endpoint marked derived-key signing, then give the receiver the new one: from then on it signs with HMAC-SHA256 keyed by the secret itself.

secret.created: Signing secret for {url}. Copy it now: it will not be shown again.
secret.rotated: New signing secret for {url}. Copy it now: it will not be shown again.
